title: API Health Check
description: A local API is running at http://127.0.0.1:18080, but its status is unknown.
mission: Send a GET request to /health and confirm that the API reports a healthy status.
success: The health endpoint was queried successfully.

lesson.what_happened: A direct health request confirmed the local API was serving successfully.
lesson.be_careful: A healthy process is not always a healthy dependency; inspect the response body too.

hints: The endpoint accepts an HTTP GET request.
curl can print an HTTP response in the terminal.
